name: Shape Drift
essence: A rush ticket lacks the seat that the consumer assumes every ticket provides.

examples.summary: A rush ticket lacks the seat that the consumer assumes every ticket provides.
examples.mechanism: Only reserved tickets initialize seat, while the consumer invokes a string method on the optional property without checking the ticket shape.
examples.observed_output: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')
examples.expected_behavior: Display a standing-area label for a rush ticket.

ingredients.suggests: The seat is initialized only for reserved tickets.
The seat consumer assumes that every ticket supplies a usable seat string.
